title: 第20章 净火教二第21章 解决一
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
听到对方所言。
胡隆目光一闪。
他之所以知道此人真实姓名。
并非是利用什么电脑技术查找的。
他之前查找到关于对方个人信息记录的名字就是刘氏。
而他之所以知道的这么清楚。
那是因为浮现在眼前的光幕。
【目标:刘菱歌】
【技能一：青囊残卷·引魂篇（熟练）大小:1M（状态:可下载）】
……
【技能二：经咒口传（熟练）】
【大小:2M（状态:可下载）】
（说明:熟练掌握佛道术语、民间谶纬、朴素道德训诫的口诀、偈子和经文片段。
能根据不同场合进行治病、祈福、解厄。）
……
在刚才触碰到这二人的一瞬间。
两人的姓名，技能便出现在了他的眼前。
对方同样掌握青囊残卷这个技能，甚至比起薛雾更为精深一些。
至于一旁的薛海，身上并没有这个技能，拥有的只是一个熟练层次普通技能。
名为察言观色。

因此胡隆没有多管，将对方直接打晕，把注意力全部放在这位刘菱歌身上。
对方身上有两个技能，第二个并没有什么太大的用处。
只是神婆的标配，用来哄人的玩意。
至于第一个。
“熟练级的技能下载流量居然也只要一兆？”
胡隆心中一动，有些诧异。
要知道根据他这段时间的观察，就算是纯粹知识性的熟练级技能最少都需要两兆。
眼前这明显少的有些不正常。
不过他旋即便有了明悟。
或许是因为下载薛雾身上的入门技能原因。
二者本来同属一个技能。
就像是学习，一个是没有基础的人，一个是有基础的人，抛开其他的因素外。
那么二者学习起来的难度很显然是后者更为简单。
这下载技能应该也是这般道理。
思及此处，胡隆心中一动。
直接将其下载下来。
顿时间，脑海中关于这青囊残卷的内容更多了一份，一些比较晦涩的内容也更加明了一些。
可惜，熟练级的这门技能之中并未有什么关于他身上的问题记载。
不过对此他也没有失望。
收回思绪，将目光落在眼前神色死灰的刘氏身上。

这个技能提示从某方面来说，还有一个验证人身份的作用。
胡隆原本准备来利用这点，好诈对方一下。
再进行下面的询问。
可没有想到居然会有这种结果。
至于这对方所言，应该是将他当成了其他势力的人。
content_en:
Hear what the other person is saying.
Hu Long's eyes flashed.
The reason why he knew this person's real name.
It is not a search using any computer technology.
The name he had previously found about the other party's personal information records was Liu.
And the reason why he knows so clearly.
That's because of the light curtain that appeared in front of me.
[Target: Liu Lingge]
[Skill 1: Green Bag Fragment·Soul-inducing Chapter (Proficient) Size: 1M (Status: Downloadable)]
…
[Skill 2: Oral transmission of mantras (proficient)]
[Size: 2M (Status: Downloadable)]
(Explanation: Be proficient in Buddhist and Taoist terminology, folk prophecies, simple moral admonitions, verses and scripture fragments.
It can cure diseases, pray for blessings, and relieve misfortunes according to different occasions. )
…
The moment I touched these two people just now.
The names and skills of the two people appeared in front of him.
The other party also mastered the skill of Qingsang Fragments, even more sophisticated than Xue Wu.
As for Xue Hai on the side, he does not have this skill, he only has an ordinary skill at the proficiency level.
It's called observing words and colors.
Therefore, Hu Long did not take any more care, knocked the opponent unconscious directly, and focused all his attention on Liu Lingge.
The opponent has two skills, but the second one is not of much use.
It's just a standard equipment of the Goddess, a thing used to coax people.
As for the first one.
"The download traffic for proficient-level skills is only 1 megabyte?"
Hu Long's heart moved and he was a little surprised.
You must know that according to his observations during this period, even purely knowledge-based proficiency-level skills require at least two trillion.
The obvious lack in front of me is a bit abnormal.
But he soon had an enlightenment.
Perhaps it was because of the entry-level skills downloaded from Xue Wu.
The two originally belong to the same skill.
Just like learning, one is a person without a foundation, and the other is a person with a foundation, regardless of other factors.
So the difficulty of learning the two is obviously that the latter is easier.
This download skill should be the same.
Thinking of this, Hu Long's heart moved.
Download it directly.
After a while, there was more content about the remaining scroll in my mind, and some of the more obscure content became clearer.
Unfortunately, there is no record of any problems with him in this proficient level skill.
But he was not disappointed.
Withdrawing his thoughts, he turned his gaze to Liu, who looked ashen in front of him.
From a certain perspective, this skill tip also serves the function of verifying a person's identity.
Hu Long originally planned to take advantage of this to deceive the other party.
Make the following inquiries again.
But I didn't expect that there would be such a result.
As for what the other party said, he should be regarded as someone from other forces.
